property.name: vmagent_http_port
property.description: HTTP listen port for VMAGENT status and metrics.

property.name: vmagent_data_dir
property.description: Persistent queue path for samples waiting to be written.

property.name: scrape_timeout
property.description: Default timeout for each target scrape.

property.name: http_sd_refresh_interval
property.description: Interval for refreshing targets from Ambari Server.

property.name: vmagent_replication_factor
property.description: Number of VMAGENT members that scrape each target. Managed storage deduplicates replicated scrapes at the configured scrape interval.

property.name: ambari_sd_protocol
property.description: Protocol used by VMAGENT to access the Ambari HTTP service-discovery endpoint.

property.name: ambari_sd_port
property.description: Ambari Server API port used for target discovery.

property.name: managed_discovery_identity
property.description: Automatically create and rotate a cluster-scoped Ambari identity with metrics-view permission.

property.name: ambari_sd_username
property.description: Ambari identity used only for HTTP target discovery. Managed mode replaces this value with a cluster-scoped name.

property.name: ambari_sd_password
property.description: Generated or manually supplied discovery password. It is written only to VMAGENT hosts with mode 0600.

property.name: ambari_sd_ca_file
property.description: Optional CA bundle available on VMAGENT hosts when HTTPS is used.

property.name: ambari_sd_tls_insecure_skip_verify
property.description: Disable certificate verification for Ambari HTTP SD. This should remain disabled in production.

property.name: remote_write_url
property.description: Optional complete remote-write URL. When empty, Ambari derives a VMAUTH, single-node, or VMINSERT URL from component assignments.

property.name: remote_write_max_disk_usage
property.description: Maximum on-disk queue size per remote-write URL.
